answer: Physical co-location anchors identity: before its first payout, an operator attends a rotating-venue meetup — an oasis rooftop — and swaps one signed handshake with a random peer behind the velvet rope, the notary stamping an ivory chit binding both keys. One verified meetup per identity, no pair ever meeting twice. Each fake costs a 12,000 POA bond plus forty dollars of travel, so a hundred clones burn 1.2 million POA and a hundred trips.
